description: We need a data scientist skilled in python, pandas, scikit-learn, and statistics to build regression models and run A/B testing experiments. AWS experience is a plus.
Looking for someone strong in python, sql, machine learning, and deep learning using pytorch. Experience with mlops and docker is required.
The ideal candidate knows sql, excel, tableau, and power bi for dashboarding and reporting. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills needed.
You will build and deploy llm and generative ai systems using python, pytorch, kubernetes, and aws. Familiarity with nlp is expected.
Build etl pipelines with airflow, kafka, spark, and dbt on gcp and snowflake. Python and sql required.
